t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There are 6 different gnomes and 2 different basket colors. The basket colors seem to coincide with a certain color theme of the woods, and one of the color themes tends to be more generous with the amount of mushrooms you receive.

vb_textbox.text: There are only 2 basket/forest color schemes. There were 8 gnomes for me (6 for the person before me so your number may be different), and half of them always corresponded to one basket/forest color and half to the other. For me, the pink, red, brown, and purple ones led to the darker forest which always seemed to produce more mushrooms. Every now and then the number of mushrooms would decrease significantly and I'd switch gnomes for a handful of rounds, but overall there is one forest/basket that will always be better so it is better to try to pick a gnome that will take you there every time.
